# ERAG Documentation

ERAG — Engineer • Research • Advance • Grow. GitHub organization: https://github.com/the-erag

> Official documentation for ERAG open-source packages for Laravel, Vue 3, and React. Built and maintained by Er Amit Gupta.

## Packages

- [Laravel Disposable Email](https://erag.in/laravel-disposable-email/): High-performance disposable and temporary email address validator for Laravel with DNS/MX verification, auto-syncing blacklists, and caching.
- [Laravel Inertia Toast](https://erag.in/laravel-inertia-toast/): Lightweight toast notifications and promise-based confirmation dialog modals for Laravel and Inertia.js (Vue 3 and React).
- [Laravel Lang Sync Inertia](https://erag.in/laravel-lang-sync-inertia/): Export and sync Laravel language translation files to Inertia.js applications with Vue, React, and Svelte i18n helpers.
- [Phone Number Vue](https://erag.in/phone-number-vue/): Headless Vue 3 composable (usePhoneNumber) for country-aware phone input, dial codes, auto formatting, and validation.
- [Phone Number React](https://erag.in/phone-number-react/): Headless React hook (usePhoneNumber) for country-aware phone input, dial codes, auto formatting, and validation in React 18 & 19.
- [Laravel PWA](https://erag.in/laravel-pwa/): Turn Laravel apps into Progressive Web Apps (PWA) with manifest generation, service workers, custom install prompts, and logo uploads.
- [Vue Toastification](https://erag.in/vue-toastification/): Smooth Apple-style toast notifications and promise-based confirmation modals for Vue 3 using the Composition API.
- [Text Editor Vue](https://erag.in/text-editor-vue/): Dependency-free Vue 3 rich text editor (WYSIWYG) with mentions (@), merge tags ({{), templates, image uploads, tables, and HTML controls.
- [Laravel Inertia Forms](https://erag.in/laravel-inertia-forms/): Define Laravel forms in PHP and render them in Inertia.js with one Form component for Vue, React, or Svelte, with generated validation, conditional fields, and file uploads.
- [Text Editor React](https://erag.in/text-editor-react/): Dependency-free React rich text editor (WYSIWYG) for React 18 & 19 with mentions (@), merge tags ({{), templates, image uploads, tables, and HTML controls.

## Blog

- [ERAG Blog](https://erag.in/blog/): Practical guides by Amit Gupta for Laravel, Inertia.js, Vue and React developers, covering the problems each ERAG package solves. RSS: https://erag.in/blog/feed.xml
